# sapintegrationsuite_alternative_partner (Data Source)

Reads an existing Partner Directory alternative partner mapping by its (agency, scheme, external_id) tuple, without managing it as a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_alternative_partner" "sender" {
  agency      = "Sender_1"
  scheme      = "SenderInterface"
  external_id = "Interface_1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agency` (String) The external scheme agency identifier.
- `external_id` (String) The external identifier within agency/scheme.
- `scheme` (String) The external identification scheme.

### Optional

- `runtime_location_id` (String) Runtime location ID of the Edge Integration Cell to address, for example "myedge". Leave unset for the cloud runtime. SAP shows the ID in the Integration Suite monitoring URL after selecting the Edge Integration Cell as runtime ({"edge":{"runtimeLocationId":"myedge"}}). Requests then go to /location/<id>/api/v1 on the same tenant host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form "<hex_agency>/<hex_scheme>/<hex_external_id>".
- `partner_id` (String) The internal Partner ID (Pid) this external identity resolves to.
